property_summary: For any nonzero address embedded as the first immutable arg, a call to owner() with a well-formed 20-byte immutable-args trailer returns exactly that address; the mutant reads offset 0x28 (out of the args block) and returns address(0), breaking the rule.
change_summary: Read the immutable arg at offset 0x28 (debt token address) instead of 0x0 (owner).
